messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 PROD alert: GPU node pool (prod-west-1-gpu) at 98% allocation. Autoscaler failing to converge. Queue depth increasing. Pager triggered.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. Joining bridge now. Starting triage.

ml-serving: Seeing request queue growth on batch workers — tail latency > 8s for embeddings endpoints. Customers seeing throttled requests.

support-pm: Multiple customers reporting 503s and increased errors, CS triaging impact. Will post ETA updates.

eng-infra-lead: Quick check — any recent LT or AMI rollouts? Could be launch template drift + taint propagation.

ml-serving: No config changes in the last 2 hours from model deploys.

sre-oncall: Running quick checks:
```
kubectl get pods -n ml-serving -l app=embedder -o wide
kubectl get nodes -l instance-type=gpu -o wide
kubectl describe clusterautoscaler -n kube-system
```

sre-oncall: Cluster-autoscaler logs show repeated attachrole errors: "unable to assume role for nodegroup prod-gpu-ng: AccessDenied" — looks like IAM passrole failing intermittently.

eng-infra-lead: Hmm. We saw a partial attachrole policy rotation earlier; maybe rollout didn't finish. Checking cloud logs now.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-4278. Severity: Sev2. Bridge: https://redwood/bridges/INC-2025-4278 (auto).

customer-ops: Customer impact: 12 accounts affected, elevated error rate, some P99 latency spikes. CS has pre-baked message ready.

sre-oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) Temporarily scale a fallback GPU nodegroup with older LT/role that still works. 2) Route a fraction of traffic to dedicated fallback pool. 3) Force autoscaler cooldown reset.

eng-infra-lead: I'm provisioning fallback nodegroup (prod-gpu-fallback) with known-good launch template and instance profile. Giving it a higher priority in routing for 10% of requests.

sre-oncall: Commands I'm running:
```
aws autoscaling create-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name prod-gpu-fallback --launch-configuration-name lt-prod-gpu-v1 --min-size 0 --max-size 6 --desired-capacity 2
kubectl annotate nodegroup prod-gpu-fallback priority=high --overwrite
```

ml-serving: Can we shift a canary weight to fallback? I can flip routing rule in 5m. Need to watch model warmup.

support-pm: CS update sent: "We're aware of elevated errors for embeddings in prod-west-1 and are actively mitigating; next update in 30m."

eng-infra-lead: Cloud logs confirm the attachrole failure originates from a mis-synced IAM condition on the new LT. Rolling back the LT version to v17 (last known good).

sre-oncall: After fallback ASG up, I see new nodes register and pods scheduling. Queue length reduced by ~40% in 6 minutes.

ml-serving: Latency improving. P95 back within SLO but P99 still elevated due to backfill. Continuing to drain hotspot queues.

incident-bot: Note: autoscaler cooldown timer reset at 1759123600 by sre-oncall.

eng-infra-lead: Action items: 1) Reconcile launch template IAM condition and re-run rollout in canary. 2) Add extra validation to LT CI to prevent unsynced condition. 3) Postmortem owner: eng-infra-lead.

customer-ops: Customers on the bridge: @acme-prod, @beta-ml. CS rep on call with acme, passing status.

sre-oncall: Handoff: I'm staying on until nodes stabilize. If queue depth drops below 20% and error rate < 1.5% sustained for 15m, will hand to night oncall. Estimated 30–45m.

support-pm: Next public update scheduled in 25m.

ml-serving: Quick note — we saw taints applied incorrectly to new nodes earlier (`node.kubernetes.io/unschedulable:NoSchedule`) — I removed taint for fallback nodes to allow immediate scheduling. Add LT fix to ensure no default taint.

eng-infra-lead: Confirmed. Adding taint-checker to nodegroup validation.

sre-oncall: Monitoring: queue depth grafana link https://grafana/d/queues/prod-west1, autoscaler events: https://console/events/cluster-autoscaler.

incident-bot: Severity reduced to Sev3 at 1759123720 (impact contained, customers being routed to fallback).

customer-ops: Preparing post-incident customer summary. Please add timeline notes and root cause when available.

eng-infra-lead: Root cause provisional: Launch Template IAM condition rotation created temporary passrole failures causing autoscaler to fail to attach instance profile -> scale-out blocked -> queue growth.

sre-oncall: Will document commands and timestamps in the incident runbook. Handoff to @sre-oncall-night at 1759123789. Leaving bridge to infra lead for cleanup.

sre-oncall-night: Acknowledged handoff. Will monitor for next 2 hours and escalate if degradation returns.

incident-bot: Incident retired from active paging at 1759123789 (bridge remains open for cleanup).
